title: Disassembly Instructions for Progressive Cavity Pump
overview:
>This document provides step-by-step instructions for disassembling a Progressive Cavity Pump.

**Important:** This document is intended for experienced technicians only. Follow all safety guidelines and precautions when working with electrical components and moving parts.

steps.title: Remove the set plug for the drive pin
steps.description: Loosen the bolt that holds the set plug in place.

steps.title: Screw out the hold-down plug
steps.description: Loosen the bolts that hold the hold-down plug in place and remove it from the housing.

steps.title: Remove the alignment tool plug
steps.description: Loosen the bolt that holds the alignment tool plug in place and remove it from the housing.

steps.title: Remove the drive pin
steps.description: Gently tap on the drive pin to loosen it, then remove it with your leveraged pipe for the pipe wrench.

steps.title: Remove the cap screws
steps.description: Use a 3-8 drive, 3-quarter inch socket to remove the cap screws from the housing.

steps.title: Remove the cap
steps.description: Carefully pull out the cap and set it aside.

steps.title: Mark the position of the cap
steps.description: Leave a mark on the side of the cap or the side of the housing to ensure the cap is properly reassembled.

steps.title: Remove the stator and rotor as one piece from the housing
steps.description: Use a large pipe wrench to secure it tightly, then use a leverage bar pipe to unscrew the stator and rotor from the housing.

steps.title: Slide out the stator and rotor with assistance
steps.description: Have a helper slide the stator and rotor out of the housing assembly once it starts to turn easily.

steps.title: Remove the connecting rod washer
steps.description: Carefully pull out the connecting rod washer and set it aside.

steps.title: Inspect for damage or defects
steps.description: Verify that the connecting rod washer is in good condition and properly seated on the end of the connecting rod.
